ValidationRule.description: Tracking numbers are validated by a carrier-specific CASE ladder of length and prefix rules, plus a no-spaces / uppercase check.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Tracking_Number__c)), OR( CASE(TEXT(Carrier__c), 'UPS', IF(AND(BEGINS(Tracking_Number__c, '1Z'), LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 18), 0, 1), 'FedEx', IF(OR(LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 12, LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 15), 0, 1), 'DHL', IF(AND(LEN(Tracking_Number__c) = 10, ISNUMBER(Tracking_Number__c)), 0, 1), 0) = 1, Tracking_Number__c <> UPPER(Tracking_Number__c), CONTAINS(Tracking_Number__c, ' ') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tracking Number does not match the carrier's format.
